column1: # Every todo-list style pack that has shipped, so `agent-style.sh status` can name the
# version a global instruction file holds. One row per distinct file: sha256, the pack
# (claude = assets/CLAUDE.md, codex = assets/AGENTS.md), the first plugin version that
# shipped it, and the commit. "-pre" marks content that reached main under a version
# number but was replaced before that version was tagged.
# When you change a pack, add its row here in the same change; tests/style-contract.sh
# fails until the shipped packs and every historical one are listed.
